name: AWS IAM Access Key Created
description: Successful aws iam access key created; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: Synthetic AWS IAM AdministratorAccess Policy Attachment
description: Successful attachment of AWS managed AdministratorAccess to an IAM user, group or role. Synthetic lab only.
query: (eventSource:iam.amazonaws.com AND (eventName:(AttachUserPolicy OR AttachRolePolicy OR AttachGroupPolicy)) AND requestParameters.policyArn:arn\:aws\:iam\:\:aws\:policy\/AdministratorAccess) AND (NOT _exists_:errorCode)

name: AWS CloudTrail Trail Deleted
description: Successful aws cloudtrail trail deleted; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: AWS CloudTrail Logging Stopped
description: Successful aws cloudtrail logging stopped; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.

name: AWS Successful Console Login Without MFA
description: Successful aws successful console login without mfa; behavioral signal, not proof of malicious intent. Raw provider field contract; synthetic tests only.
query: (eventSource:signin.amazonaws.com AND eventName:ConsoleLogin AND responseElements.ConsoleLogin:Success AND additionalEventData.MFAUsed:No) AND (NOT _exists_:errorCode)

query: category:ApplicationManagement AND activityDisplayName:"Add service principal credentials" AND loggedByService:"Core Directory" AND result:success
